## Web search (allow-listed)
Called by the chat agent as **search_web** when a question asks about *current* regulations, recent changes or best practices, or the documents don't answer it.

One call to the Azure OpenAI **Responses API** with its built-in **web_search** tool, restricted to an **allow-list of authoritative domains** (by default federal: EPA, eCFR, Federal Register, FHWA, NRCS, USACE, FEMA, NOAA/USGS — plus any state or local domains you add). Two scopes: **verified** (allow-list only — the agent's *search_web*) and **open** (the wider web — *search_open_web*). Every source comes back tagged verified/unverified, so answers keep three separate sections: **From your documents** · **From verified public sources** · **From the wider web — not on the verified list**.

Privacy: only a short model-written search query leaves Azure (to the web search provider); the agent is instructed never to put document text, file names, project names or people in a query.
